## Item 33 — Accounts breakdown on the balance widget (size-responsive) 🔵

- **Status:** ✅ **DONE `8e2f2ef`** (2026-07-14; grilled → built → two on-device feedback rounds folded in pre-commit, both driven by Alvin's real-device testing; round-2 colors/names committed on Alvin's go, device pass to ride the next install). **Model: booked Sonnet-medium, built on Opus** (the feedback rounds — wipe-repaint root-cause, lock-gate reversal, grace-elapse re-mask — were Opus-grade cross-cutting work). Non-paywall. No Room/schema change (stays **v25**); one new dependency (`glance-material3`).
- **As-built deviations from the plan below:** `balance_widget_info.xml` sizing was **not** bumped — `targetCell` stays 2×1 (the default drop size) and the tall form is reached purely by resizing (`resizeMode` was already `horizontal|vertical`); the Q4 lock gate was reversed (round 1); widgets render **brand Rose** instead of default dynamic color (round 2).
- **Files touched (21):** new `feature/accounts/domain/{model/AccountBalance, usecase/ObserveAccountBalancesUseCase}`, new `feature/widget/presentation/WidgetTheme.kt`, new `res/layout/balance_widget_preview.xml`; `feature/widget/presentation/{BalanceWidget, WidgetDisplay}`, `feature/accounts/presentation/AccountsViewModel` (reorder repaint), `core/session/LocalDataWiper` (post-wipe repaint), `feature/settings/data/PrivacyModeRepositoryImpl` (grace-elapse repaint), `MainActivity` (widget route latch + onStop repaint), `navigation/IponApp` (deep-link `switchTab`), `AndroidManifest` (receiver labels), `res/{values/strings, xml/balance_widget_info, xml/add_transaction_widget_info}`, `gradle/libs.versions.toml` + `app/build.gradle.kts` (`glance-material3`).
- **Tests:** +12 tier-1 JVM (`BuildAccountRowsTest` ×5, `ObserveAccountBalancesUseCaseTest` ×5, `LocalDataWiperTest` +2) − 2 deleted `WidgetDisplayTest` lock cases; suite **920 green**.
- **Decision (2026-07-14):** **same widget, not a separate one.** Manage → Accounts is a net-assets header over a scrollable account list, so the widget mirrors that via **`SizeMode.Responsive`**: compact renders just the Item 32 net-assets glance; tall renders the same header **plus a scrollable `LazyColumn`** of accounts. One privacy/lock/refresh model and one entry point serve both forms — the user picks detail by resizing. Rejected two separate widgets (overlapping data, double maintenance, a "which widget?" choice).
- **Feasibility confirmed:** Glance supports `LazyColumn` (`androidx.glance.appwidget.lazy`) — flat vertical scroll, RemoteView-backed. Caveats: no nested scroll, keep rows simple, per-row `actionRunCallback`/`actionStartActivity`. **Account icons are `Icons.Filled.*` `ImageVector`s** (`ACCOUNT_ICONS`) — Glance/RemoteViews **cannot** render an `ImageVector` (needs an `ImageProvider`: drawable res / `Bitmap` / `Uri`), so per-account glyphs aren't free; resolved to a **color dot** below.

**Grilled build plan (2026-07-14):**

- **Responsive mechanism (Q1):** `SizeMode.Responsive` with **two pinned `DpSize`s** — compact ≈ `110×64dp` (**byte-identical** to the Item 32 glance) and tall ≈ `180×220dp` (header + list). Chosen over `SizeMode.Exact`/height-branching so the compact form is pinned exactly and Android 12+ pre-renders both (no resize flicker/re-fetch). Bump `res/xml/balance_widget_info.xml` sizing (`targetCellHeight`/`maxHeight`, keep `resizeMode="horizontal|vertical"`) so the tall size is reachable by resizing.
- **Tall layout:** **fixed header** (same "Net assets" total + eye + refresh as Item 32) in a `Column` **above** the scrollable `LazyColumn` (header stays put, list scrolls).
- **Which accounts (Q2):** own + shared-by-me, **active only** (archived excluded — the header sums active-only, so rows sum to the header; archived are intentionally out-of-sight), **`position` order** (same as Manage → Accounts; `ObserveAccountsUseCase` already sorts `position ASC, createdAt ASC`). Shared accounts **included, no badge**.
- **Row content (Q3):** **color dot** (`parseHexColor(account.color)`, neutral `GlanceTheme` fallback when null — mirrors the in-app colored circle) · **name** · **derived balance**. **No icon glyphs** (the `ImageVector` constraint above — bundling 15 vector-drawable copies is a clean *additive* later upgrade if the widget becomes a showcase surface). Negative balances render **plain with a natural minus sign** (no red/green — calm/glanceable, matches the header).
- **Privacy / lock (Q4), extends `resolveWidgetDisplay`:** ~~hard mask on no-session **or** set-PIN lock~~ → **REVERSED on Alvin's first on-device pass (2026-07-14): the app lock does NOT gate the widget** — parity with the quick-add widget, which needs no unlock/PIN/biometric. **Hard mask = no session only** (masked header, **list suppressed entirely** + a "Sign in to view" line — a signed-out home screen still hides names + count). For a logged-in user the **only** mask is the soft privacy model: the **single eye toggles the whole widget** (header + every row amount together); **names stay visible**, amounts → `•••••`; peek re-hides on next refresh via the existing `userToggled` reset. The widget drops its app-lock reads entirely (`WidgetEntryPoint` loses both lock accessors); Item 32's lock-time hard mask is thus retired too.
- **Taps + deep-link (Q5):** header/body **and each row** → open **Manage → Accounts** (nav to `NavRegistry.MANAGE.graphRoute()` → Manage defaults to page 0 = the Accounts sub-tab, so no sub-tab arg needed). Plumbing: widget `actionStartActivity` → `MainActivity` with an intent extra (e.g. `start_route=manage`) → after the NavController is up, navigate to Manage, **mirroring the existing `handleAuthDeepLink` pattern**. In Glance each `LazyColumn` row needs its **own** `actionStartActivity` (the outer clickable doesn't cover scrolled items) — all point to the same destination. **Rows are not individually targeted** (no per-account detail screen exists; the list is one glance away). This also **retroactively fixes Item 32's** body-tap (which today just opens the start destination). Refresh + eye keep their own tap targets.
- **List edge cases (Q6):** **no row cap** — show all active accounts, scroll (counts are naturally single-digit; `LazyColumn` handles it). Empty (0 active accounts) → a muted **"No accounts yet"** line.
- **Picker (Q7):** `android:description` → **"Balance & accounts"** (disambiguate from the Quick-add widget) + a tall-form `previewLayout` so the picker preview shows the account list.
- **Data snapshot + freshness (Q9):** new **`ObserveAccountBalancesUseCase`** (active accounts, `position` order, each with its `AccountBalanceCalculator`-derived balance; shared accounts show the **combined** shared balance per ADR-0018) exposed via `WidgetEntryPoint`, read as a `.first()` snapshot — keeps data access in a UseCase (CLAUDE.md scalability principle) and stays symmetric with `ObserveNetAssetsUseCase`. **Add `Widgets.updateAll` after `reorderAccounts`** in `AccountsViewModel` (new — reorder changes row order, which Item 32's save/archive/delete triggers don't cover; share/unshare left alone — no badge means the visible row is unchanged, and balance impact rides the existing `SyncWorker`-completion refresh).
- **Tests (JVM, mirrors `WidgetDisplayTest`):** extend `resolveWidgetDisplay` (list-visibility suppressed under hard mask) + new pure **`buildAccountRows(accounts, balances, symbol, revealed) : List<AccountRowDisplay>`** (`(name, dotColorHex, amountText-or-null)`) — cases: hard-mask → no rows; soft-hide → names present + amounts masked; revealed → real amounts; archived excluded; `position` order preserved; empty → empty list. `ObserveAccountBalancesUseCase` gets its own test. Glance UI + the deep-link verified by running.

**On-device feedback round 1 (Alvin, 2026-07-14) — 1 design reversal + 3 fixes folded in before commit:**

- **App-lock gate dropped (the Q4 reversal above):** `resolveWidgetDisplay` loses `isPinSet`/`isLocked` (hard mask = no session only); the widget no longer injects any app-lock state. The two `WidgetDisplayTest` lock cases deleted with it.
- **Obs 1 — eye button mis-taps (~80%):** the 22dp eye floated directly after the amount text, so its position shifted between masked (`•••••`, narrow) and revealed (wide) and most taps hit the open-app body click. Fix: the eye is **pinned to the amount row's far right** (`fillMaxWidth` + weight spacer — fixed position in both states) inside a **48×36dp tap box** (24dp glyph). Same fix serves both forms (shared `AmountRow`).
- **Obs 2 — CRITICAL: previous account's balances lingered on the widget ~30–60s after switching accounts.** Root cause: `LocalDataWiper.wipe()` (shared purge for sign-out / account-switch / delete-account, ADR-0021) never repainted the widget; the only sign-out repaint was a **composition-scoped `LaunchedEffect`** in `MainActivity`'s Unauthenticated branch, which is **cancelled mid-`updateAll`** when a quick re-login flips the branch — so the stale paint survived until the new account's first sync completed. Fix: `LocalDataWiper` injects `WidgetRefresher` and repaints **after** the wipe (`runCatching` — a cosmetic repaint failure must never fail the wipe, whose partial-run ordering invariants are load-bearing); on the sign-out path this rides `AuthViewModel`'s existing `NonCancellable` wipe wrapper, so it can't be cancelled. Covers all three wipe paths. +2 `LocalDataWiperTest` cases (repaint-after-clear ordering; wipe survives a repaint throw).
- **Obs 3 — new accounts took 1–2 min to appear on the widget.** The interactive foreground `syncEngine.sync()` never repaints the widget (only the background `SyncWorker` does), and on Alvin's ROM (aggressive process freezing) an in-app `updateAll` can be deferred once backgrounded. Fix: `MainActivity.onStop` now fires `Widgets.updateAll` — backgrounding the app is exactly when the user is about to look at the widget, and it's the last reliable in-process moment before a freeze; also picks up any in-app privacy toggle. **Caveat (told to Alvin):** repaints while the widget is already visible on a frozen process remain OEM-throttled — that residual lag is not fixable client-side.
- **Consequence fix — grace-elapse re-mask:** with the lock gate gone, the session privacy re-hide (Item 25) is the only mask a logged-in user has, but the widget repaint on lock transitions dedups away for **no-PIN** users (`isLocked` never cycles). `PrivacyModeRepositoryImpl`'s `autoLockElapsed` collector now calls `widgetRefresher.refresh()` **after** setting hidden — deterministic ordering (flag flips before the repaint reads it), so a revealed widget re-masks at the same ~30s boundary as the app.

**On-device feedback round 2 (Alvin, 2026-07-14) — brand colors + widget names, folded in pre-commit:**

- **Balance widget was purple, quick-add pink.** Cause: two color strategies — `AddTransactionWidget` hardcodes brand pink (`0xFFFFD9E3`/`0xFF9F3758`), while `BalanceWidget` used the default `GlanceTheme` = **Material You dynamic color** on Android 12+ (wallpaper-derived; M3 baseline purple `#6750A4` pre-12). Fix: new `WidgetTheme.kt` exposes `IponWidgetColors = ColorProviders(light/dark)` built from the app's own `paletteColorScheme(ThemePalette.ROSE, isDark)` — the balance widget now renders **brand Rose in both system light and dark**, matching quick-add. New dependency: **`glance-material3`** (same 1.1.0 version ref; the `ColorScheme`→Glance adapter). Deliberately **static Rose**, not the user's chosen Personalize palette — following the palette (incl. its G8 premium interaction) is a separate item if ever wanted.
- **Widget names in the picker:** both receivers previously fell back to the app label, so the picker showed two anonymous "Love, Ipon" widgets. Both get `android:label` — **"Balance & accounts"** and **"Quick add"** — and real descriptions ("Net assets at a glance — resize to see each account." / "Add a transaction in one tap.").

## Item 34 — Settings refactor: sub-screens for Appearance + Finance, Sync first ✅

- **Status:** ✅ DONE `812a5b6` (2026-07-14). **Model: Sonnet, medium effort** — pure UI + navigation reorganization pattern-following the existing Settings sub-screen routes (Profile/Security/Couple); no data-layer, sync, or schema change (stays **v25**). Specifically: color palette + dark mode wrapped into a single subsetting (or recommend a better idea); currency + hide amounts as a subsetting under a Finance section; Sync should be the first item.
- **Change (recommended target IA):** the root becomes a short, scannable list — Sync card on top, then nav rows only; the two inline pickers (palette grid, currency grid) move to sub-screens. Sub-screens over inline collapsibles: the root's other entries are already nav rows, the palette/currency grids are what make the scroll long, and the app has no expand/collapse idiom anywhere else.
  1. **Sync first** — the existing `SyncCard` (Item 9) moves to the top of the root.
  2. **New "Appearance" sub-screen** — nav row (`Palette icon · "Appearance" · "Theme, colors & dark mode"`) → screen holding the palette grid + Light/Dark switch + the **Apply** button. **ADR-0014 semantics preserved exactly:** live preview stays local ViewModel draft state (never persisted on tap), Apply writes DataStore; the locked-palette → paywall route (`onLockedPaletteTap()` returning its `upsell_tap` source string, Item 21 contract) threads through via `onOpenPremium`. Split `Appearance{Screen,ViewModel,UiState}` out of `Personalize*`.
  3. **New "Finance" sub-screen** — nav row (`"Finance" · "Currency, privacy & budget cycle"`) → currency symbol grid (Item 18) + "Hide amounts" switch (Item 15) + "Budget month starts on" row/dialog (Item 10b). All three keep their instant write-through (no Apply gate). Hide-amounts lands under Finance per Alvin's call — it masks money, so Finance beats keeping a one-item Privacy section.
  4. **Root rows otherwise unchanged in place:** Profile, Premium (enforcement-gated, Item 12), Security, Couple, Edit navbar; then Support, Beta (beta builds only), Sign out. The `TutorialTargets.SETTINGS_COUPLE` coach-mark stays on the root Couple row.
  - `PersonalizeViewModel` sheds the appearance draft + finance/privacy/currency state into the two new VMs (it currently runs two chained `combine`s at the 5-flow max — this splits it naturally into three thin ones); the root VM keeps sync status + premium-entry visibility. Session privacy-mode behavior (Item 25's `MutableStateFlow` repo) is untouched — only the switch's screen moves.
  - **Files:** [PersonalizeScreen.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/settings/presentation/PersonalizeScreen.kt) / [PersonalizeViewModel.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/settings/presentation/PersonalizeViewModel.kt) / [PersonalizeUiState.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/settings/presentation/PersonalizeUiState.kt); new `Appearance*` + `Finance*` siblings in the same folder; [IponApp.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/navigation/IponApp.kt) (two new routes inside the Settings nav graph, `popBackStack` pattern). No repository/UseCase/domain change.
- **Verify:** `assembleStagingDebug` + `testStagingDebugUnitTest` green (no VM test exists for `Personalize*`, so nothing migrates; no new logic → no new tier-1 tests — pure Composable/nav reshuffle, verified by running per Testing Policy). On-device by Alvin (stagingDebug, his device): Sync card first; Appearance live-preview reverts on back-without-Apply and persists on Apply; locked palette → paywall from the sub-screen; Finance writes are instant and survive re-entry; Couple coach-mark still anchors; Premium row still appears only under a staging enforcement flip.
